question: **Which programme is highlighted as crucial in improving Olympic preparation?**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage highlights the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** as a crucial programme that has significantly improved India's Olympic preparation.
 
• TOPS provides athletes with **international-level coaching, world-class facilities, sports science support, nutrition, and psychological training**.
 
• It represents a major shift toward structured and scientific athlete development in India.
 
• Other programmes like the Fit India Movement or Mission Khel Udaan are not mentioned in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Relevant Line from the Passage:** *“With the establishment of bodies like the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** … Indian athletes now enjoy improved access to international-level coaching, nutrition, and psychological training.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Mission Khel Udaan:** Not discussed in the passage.
 
• **Olympic Gold Hunt:** Not mentioned and not the focus here.
 
• **Fit India Movement:** Promotes fitness but unrelated to elite Olympic preparation.
 
• **TOPS:** Provides targeted support to India's top medal prospects—hence the correct choice.
